parse_frame_range_string: parse a comma-separated frame range string like 1-10,15,21-40 into a NamedOptionalSet
create_FrameRange_object: create a FrameRange object from an OptionalSet to compute indices of frames in a specified range
use_OptionalSet_intersection: use the OptionalSet intersection method to find common frames between two OptionalSet instances
get_FrameRange_frames: get a sorted list of all frame indices from a FrameRange object using the frames method
get_FrameRange_first_frame: get the first frame index from a FrameRange object using the first_frame method
